title: Rhinoplasty Nasal Fracture Evidence Diagnoses
description: The six ICD-10-CM nasal-fracture diagnoses in the approved Primary Diagnosis list. These codes may support History of Nasal Fracture with clinician confirmation and provide trauma evidence for composite rules involving M95.0 or J34.2.
